answer_1.quote: In this paper we focused on social media platforms where millions of users express their opinions and attitudes in conversations about issues of their interest, therefore we explored stance detection from SMPs.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include counterfactual rationales (e.g., Accept, Reject, No Stance explanations) and final stance predictions for social media posts with respect to topics or frames of communication.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of stance detection on the test collections from SemEval-2016, COVAXFRAMES, and MMVAX-STANCE we use the Precision (P), Recall (R), and F 1 metrics for detecting the Accept and Reject values of stance.

answer_3.quote: Finally, the LLM (or LMM) verifies which of the three explanations is most likely, using Chain-of-Verification prompting, leading to the final inference of the stance value v.
